text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: canary failures on prod/us-east-1 for rollout r-2026-06-xx. Alert ID: PDR-98231
Priya Sinha: getting paged — I’m on it. Can anyone confirm if this is the new router rollout?
Alex Chen: yes — started canary at 2024-06-21T15:10Z via deploy pipeline. Seeing 5xx spike on /v1/generate from canary pods only.
Taylor SRE: I see elevated 5xx from canary hosts: router-canary-*. Logs show KMS decrypt errors when loading model keys.
Priya Sinha: error snippet from canary pod log: ```2024-06-21T15:12:05Z ERROR key_loader: failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/deploy-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh```
Jorge Rivera: confirmed. This looks like the deploy role doesn't have the new KMS key permission — we rotated keys yesterday and the new key ARN didn't get added to deploy-role.
Alex Chen: canary pods are failing at init, so traffic is failing over to fallback, but some requests still hit canary and get 500s. Customer impact: small percentage of generation requests failing (~2-3% global, concentrated in us-east).
Maya (support): already seeing 4 incoming customer tickets mentioning intermittent failures and bad latency. Triage asked to notify CS for potential SLA impact.
Priya Sinha: immediate mitigation: kill the canary / stop rollout. Taylor — can you flip the kill-switch? Where is that config?
Taylor SRE: flipping it now. We have a runtime feature flag: `infra.enable_new_router` in config-store. Doing a staged toggle via config-service: ```curl -X POST https://config.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"infra.enable_new_router","value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CFG_TOKEN'```
deploy-bot: Rollout pause command executed by Taylor SRE at 2024-06-21T15:17Z. Canary traffic drained.
Priya Sinha: good. That should remove canary from LB. Next step — rollback or fix perm? How long to add kms:Decrypt to deploy role?
Sam (security): IAM change is straightforward but we need to update the policy referencing the new key ARN and get approval. I can expedite — estimated 10-20 minutes for policy update and propagation.
Alex Chen: if we can’t push IAM in 15m, prefer full rollback to previous stable image to be safe. PRI: rollback will restore baseline latency; canary already paused but some pods still bounced.
Jorge Rivera: note: the new deployment also changed ENV var KMS_KEY_ID from `key-old` to `key-new` and the deploy pipeline interpolates that at rollout time. So unless deploy-role has permissions to `key-new`, init fails.
Priya Sinha: action items: (1) Taylor to confirm kill-switch succeeded and monitor LB (2) Sam to update IAM policy for deploy-role with kms:Decrypt on key-new (3) Alex to keep rollback ready and trigger if IAM not applied in 15m (4) Maya to update CS with customer impact note.
Taylor SRE: kill-switch verified. No canary traffic now. LB backend counts back to stable. Monitoring alert noise decreasing.
Sam (security): requested emergency policy change, adding statement: `{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh"}`. Pushing now, will ping when applied.
Alex Chen: prepping rollback playbook: `deploy rollback --to-tag stable-20240619 --env prod --confirm`. Will only execute if Sam says not applied in 15m.
Priya Sinha: Maya — please create a brief customer advisory: "Intermittent 500s observed for generation endpoints in us-east between 15:10-15:20 UTC due to a failed config/secret access during a canary deploy. Mitigated by pausing rollout. Engineering investigating and will update."
Maya (support): on it. Draft posted to #customer-notices, tagging CS leads.
Sam (security): policy change applied at 2024-06-21T15:23Z. IAM propagation looks healthy — tested by assuming deploy-role and running KMS decrypt test locally: ```aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://enc_key.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh --profile deploy-role``` returned plaintext.
Alex Chen: redeploying canary with fixed env now. Triggering canary rollout again at 15:28Z but with zero weight to smoke test init only.
deploy-bot: Canary start attempted at 2024-06-21T15:28Z by Alex Chen.
Taylor SRE: ramped canary to 0 weight — pods are coming up, no KMS errors on init. Health checks passing.
Priya Sinha: slowly increase to 10% and watch. We should keep the kill-switch in our back pocket if anything spikes.
Alex Chen: increased to 10% at 15:33Z. No errors for 5 minutes, 5xx rate back to baseline.
Maya (support): updating customer advisory: "Rollout resumed under observation. No further customer-facing errors observed after 15:28 UTC. We'll follow up with postmortem."
Priya Sinha: handoff — Taylor, you can own the tail-end monitoring. I'm handing off to Jorge for postmortem write-up and SOC/security follow-up with Sam. On-call shift ends in 30m for me.
Jorge Rivera: filing incident doc now: will include timeline, root cause (deploy-role missing kms:Decrypt for key-new due to key rotation + env var update), mitigation, and actions: ensure deploy pipeline validates KMS permissions pre-rollout, add a preflight check in the CI job: `aws kms describe-key --key-id $KMS_KEY_ID --profile deploy-role` and add automated test to confirm decrypt ability.
Sam (security): follow-up: recommend we add a guardrail in IAM automation so key rotations update deployment roles (or require explicit ack). I’ll open a security task.
Maya (support): CS notified customers; will keep watching ticket volume and escalate if any regressions.
Priya Sinha: closing the pager — keep channel for follow-ups. Great quick coordination everyone. :thumbsup:
